phases.title: Evidence and foundations
phases.goal: Official provider evidence, Bun/MCP/host compatibility spikes, threat model, first-provider decision

gate.text: Seven evidence rows exist with blockers recorded; compatibility spikes recorded; first provider selected; ADRs accepted

phases.rollback: Documentation only; revert the changed files

phases.title: Bun MCP kernel
phases.goal: Running stdio MCP server with the 22-tool catalog, schemas, envelopes, resources and prompts skeleton

gate.text: Inspector and Claude Code/Codex connect over stdio; stdout clean; registry equals catalog

phases.rollback: Revert src/ and package changes; bun.lock restored from git

phases.title: Persistence and security
phases.goal: bun:sqlite migrations, vault, fail-closed secrets, redacted audit, transport allowlist, sandbox, leases

gate.text: Security tests and migration recovery pass; canary never leaks

phases.rollback: Migrations have a recovery path; test homes are disposable; no real secrets exist yet

phases.title: OAuth broker
phases.goal: Provider OAuth profiles, state and PKCE, callback listener, grant lifecycle

gate.text: One real provider connects and revokes

phases.rollback: Disconnect test grants; revoke in provider account settings

phases.title: Capability and write-safety kernel
phases.goal: Truthful capability verdicts, admission control, immutable plans, trusted approvals and intent journal before any real write

gate.text: Capability matrix and approval security fixtures green

phases.rollback: Revert code; approvals and intents live only in disposable test homes

phases.title: First vertical slice
phases.goal: Selected provider: auth, identity, read, approved write, verified result

gate.text: Real acceptance test without mocks passes

phases.rollback: Delete test posts through an approved delete or manually; disable the adapter manifest

phases.title: Routing and skills
phases.goal: Tool router pipeline, 14 gateway skill manifests, deterministic plans, resources and prompts

gate.text: Same request yields a stable plan; no tool recursion

phases.title: Workflow engine
phases.goal: Journaled state machine, fan-out, reconciliation, restart recovery, cancellation, scheduler

gate.text: Crash, unknown-outcome, partial-success and two-process tests pass

phases.rollback: Revert code; disable the optional worker unit

phases.title: XN-Bridge integration
phases.goal: XN-Interact registered in both hosts and coordinated by XN-Bridge through the social domain

gate.text: Host-mediated flow passes with fixture and real provider; mappings and risk rules match the catalog

phases.rollback: Remove xn-interact host entries from backups; revert XN-Bridge config and domain changes

phases.title: Remaining adapters
phases.goal: Each provider independently verified against its available products

gate.text: Seven providers listed with correct state; coverage report with three denominators

phases.rollback: Set the adapter manifest to unavailable; revoke the provider app grant

phases.title: Token tuning
phases.goal: Success-normalized token benchmark across 14/22/31 variants, profiles, caches and result refs

gate.text: Benchmark published with tokenizer version and fixtures

phases.rollback: Catalog changes revert through git; checker enforces consistency

phases.title: Hardening and release 1
phases.goal: Threat-model tests, keyring matrix, drift detection, retention, launch checklist, DoD sign-off

gate.text: All MUST requirements verified; launch checklist signed by the owner
